scripts.build:ios: npm run build:web && eas build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && eas build --platform android --profile production
scripts.eas-build-post-install: test -s modules/bundle-server/web/www/index.html || { echo 'Web bundle missing: run npm run build:web before eas build' >&2; exit 1; }
